g.text: Component diagram — modular monolith (as implemented; folders in brackets)
Dependency rules are enforced by test/architecture.test.ts:
tracking and demand never import each other; they are connected
only through domain events wired in src/container.ts (e.g. the
stop.arrived). Repository interfaces are declared by the
implements them. Only the composition root and src/seed know
concrete persistence classes. The test checks imports only: it
does not prove that every UML operation or association matches.
